name: Portainer CE
summary: Portainer Community Edition container management UI on Docker, with the administrator account created at install.
notes: Portainer CE 2.45.3 pinned by tag and digest. The administrator is created at first start from a root-only password file, so there is no first-visitor setup window. Caddy serves it over HTTPS (Let's Encrypt with a domain, a self-signed certificate on the bare IP). The Docker socket is mounted into the container only; nothing is exposed on the network except through Caddy.

licence.note: Portainer CE image portainer/portainer-ce is Zlib. Caddy Apache-2.0. Docker Engine Apache-2.0. Portainer Business Edition features are not shipped or unlocked.
